variants.headline: Still in view: state payments fall short
variants.sub: The government has underpaid wages, unemployment benefit and pensions, each by an equal proportion.
variants.body:
State wages, unemployment benefit and pensions have all been paid short by the same share. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

Same share, says the arithmetic. Less than owed, says the payment. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
